Class Server

java.lang.Object
de.lmu.dbs.ifi.sep25.network.Server
public class Server extends Object
Represents the game server that manages client connections, lobby management, game sessions, and communication with clients.

This class is implemented as a singleton.

      public void start()

    • broadcastMessage

      public void broadcastMessage(MessageDefinitions.Message<?> message)
      Broadcasts a message to all connected clients. If a client cannot receive the message, it will be removed from the clients list, and an error response will be sent to that client before closing its connection.
      Parameters:
      message - the message to be broadcasted to all connected clients

    • broadcastMessage

      public void broadcastMessage(MessageDefinitions.Message<?> message, ClientHandler exclude)
      Broadcasts a message to all connected clients except the specified client handler. If a client cannot receive the message, it will be removed from the clients list, and an error response will be sent to that client before closing its connection.
      Parameters:
      message - the message to be broadcasted to the clients
      exclude - the client handler to exclude from receiving the message

      public String generateUniqueName(String baseName)

    • getRealReadyOrder

      public List<ClientHandler> getRealReadyOrder()
      Returns an immutable snapshot of the current ready order of clients.

      This snapshot reflects the state of the ready order at the moment before the last getFirstReadyClient() call removed the first client from the queue. It preserves the insertion order and does not reflect later changes to the actual queue.

      Returns:
      an unmodifiable list representing the ready order of clients at snapshot time

    • startTimer

      public void startTimer()
      Handles the start of the body timer by scheduling a task to execute after a fixed delay of 30 seconds. When the timer ends, it retrieves the list of ready players from the server and broadcasts a BodyTimerEnded message containing this list.

      This method uses a single-threaded scheduled executor service to perform the delayed task execution. The task is responsible for broadcasting a message via the method `broadcastMessage`.

    • cancelTimer

      public void cancelTimer()
      Cancels the currently active timer if it is running.

      If a timer is active and not yet completed, this method will cancel it, reset the timerStarted flag, log the cancellation, and reset any related state, such as clearing ready registers.

      If no active timer exists or it is already finished, a warning is logged instead.
